# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. It is the shared source of repository instructions for Codex and Copilot, including package boundaries, Swift conventions, validation commands, documentation locations and human review requirements.

Consult the linked package documentation for task-specific details. Keep shared guidance in `AGENTS.md` rather than copying it here; update existing documentation before adding new Markdown files.
